messages:
Marta (mktg): Hey team — finalizing the release announcement for tomorrow. Need engineering signoff on changelog + docs links + rollout timing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/421 , docs draft: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 . Can we lock the rollout window by EOD?

Alex (eng): On it. Plan: canary at 08:00 PT with 10% traffic, full roll at ~11:00 PT. There's a small runtime fallback tweak I want to include; will add a note in the changelog.

Emily (docs): I reviewed the draft — mostly OK. Need final screenshots (CLI example and Console screenshot) and one API sample for the quickstart. I can push updates by 16:00 PT. Also we should add a redirect from /optimize -> /release/optimize-v2.

Jamal (pm): Webinar is scheduled at 10:00 PT. We need the demo to hit the canary so attendees see the new behavior. Can eng pin a stable variant for the demo to avoid flakiness?

Alex (eng): Yes — I'll pin the demo traffic to model variant `opt-v2-stable` and add a routing policy. I'll create a short rollback play in the changelog (how to flip back to opt-v1). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1589 .

Priya (prod-marketing): I'll draft the launch post once links are final. Need the benchmark blurb: two things — latency improvement for 8k context and unit cost reduction numbers. Can someone confirm?

Alex (eng): Benchmark snapshot: median latency ~210ms at 2k context, ~950ms at 8k (approx 2x improvement vs the previous runtime), unit token cost ~35% lower with new batching/quantization defaults. I'll paste the short blurb into changelog today.

Marta (mktg): Perfect. Also confirm SLO/alert hooks — can we get a note that #eng-oncall will get a paging alert if error rate > 1% during rollout?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by Alex at 2026-03-24T08:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Alex (eng): Canary started — 10% traffic routed to `opt-v2-stable`. Basic health checks green, sampling logs look normal. Tagging @Jamal for webinar demo routing.

Emily (docs): Pushed screenshot updates and the API quickstart. Docs URL (final): https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2?updated=1 . I added the CLI snippet and a sample response.

Marta (mktg): Thanks — I'll update the press kit with that doc URL. Priya, I'll send you the draft social copy in 20m.

Jamal (pm): Confirmed demo will point to the canary endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/demo/optimize-v2 — using the pinned variant. Also updated webinar notes to mention the benchmark numbers Alex provided.

Alex (eng): Canary healthy after 45m, pushing to 100% now. Promotion ETA 11:05 PT unless we see regressions. Rollback plan in changelog with command snippet: `make rollback RELEASE=optimize-v2` .

Marta (mktg): Copy. We plan marketing posts at 12:00 PT. If anyone wants to pause the rollout, shout now. :thumbsup:

Priya (prod-marketing): Draft received, I'll add the benchmark paragraph and finalize imagery. Will queue the social scheduling for 12:00 PT.

Alex (eng): Promotion complete at 11:06 PT, all traffic on optimize-v2. No elevated errors or latency spikes in the last 15m.

Marta (mktg): Awesome — thanks everyone. Post-rollout checklist: update changelog with final notes, confirm doc redirects, add link to press kit, and mark webinar slides with final numbers. I'll follow up with a short retro after launch.

Emily (docs): Redirect + docs meta updated.

deploy-bot: Deploy successful: optimize-v2 -> 100% traffic at 2026-03-24T11:06:00-07:00.

Jamal (pm): Great work, team. Let's freeze edits to the launch post until I give the green light in 30m.

Marta (mktg): Green light window noted. Thanks all — leaning on you for any last-minute hotfixes. :rocket:
